theses.subject: Industrial Metals
theses.thesis: Only scorable theme in the top decile of momentum with real breadth (0.846) and trend eligibility. It ranks #2 behind Gold and is the natural scorable proxy for the resources-led tape, showing the strongest combination of rank + breadth + durability among ETF-proxy names. This is a relative-leadership lean, not an edge claim.
theses.dissent: The detector's directional accuracy is 0.368 and the trend gate historically whipsaws in this mean-reverting market — leadership in ranks has been an unreliable forward signal here, so this may simply mark the top of a short resources pulse.
